description: This Java class implements the PaymentModule interface to handle PayPal Express Checkout payments within a sales system. It includes methods for initializing, authorizing, capturing, and refunding PayPal transactions, using PayPal API SDK classes and configuration settings.

classes.name: PayPalExpressCheckoutPayment
classes.description: Implements payment processing through PayPal Express Checkout, including transaction initialization, authorization, capture, and refund.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that required API credentials (api, username, signature) are provided in the integration configuration.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Method not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Authorizes a payment with PayPal using a payment token, preparing the transaction for processing.

methods.name: initPaypalTransaction
methods.description: Creates a PayPal Express Checkout transaction, setting up payment details, redirect URLs, and initiating the PayPal API call to start the checkout process.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs authorization and capture of the PayPal transaction.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund (full or partial) for a given transaction through PayPal API.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Handles the core process of executing an Express Checkout payment, including retrieving checkout details and completing the payment via PayPal API.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a PayPal transaction, converting an authorization into a completed payment.
